name: Shivamogga
registryAssessment: Official Shivamogga district and Karnataka Bhoomi land-record references were evidenced, but this attempt did not establish a city-scoped cadastral custodian or an anonymous public parcel-vector response. General national DILRMP status is not treated as city-specific registry evidence.

queries.query: Shivamogga Karnataka official cadastral parcel map Bhu Naksha Bhoomi survey map
queries.result: Found the official Shivamogga district government site, which links Land Records-Bhoomi; the official DILRMP Shivamogga district page reports cadastral-map/ULPIN status; the NIC Bhu-Naksha site confirms Karnataka customization. No city-specific open parcel geometry endpoint was exposed by these discovery results.

queries.result: Kannada discovery returned the official Shivamogga district site and references to Bhoomi/land records, plus general Bhu-Naksha information. It did not identify a public anonymous Shivamogga parcel API or safe ID-plus-geometry response.

officialSources.observation: Search result identifies the government district portal and a Land Records-Bhoomi link; direct fetch timed out in the available client.

officialSources.role: Government of India DILRMP Shivamogga district map/ULPIN status
officialSources.observation: Search result is explicitly scoped to State/UT Karnataka and District Name Shivamogga and presents cadastral-map/parcel status fields; direct open returned a 502 in the web client.
Search result lists Karnataka among states customized/integrated with Bhu-Naksha; it is a general national agency reference, not proof of an accessible Shivamogga parcel layer.
Anonymous HTTPS GET timed out after 20 seconds; no viewer JavaScript, endpoint, schema, CRS, or geometry was obtained.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was obtained from an anonymous public response. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted; timeout/failed viewer retrieval is not evidence of citywide absence.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Shivamogga district government land-record reference, Karnataka Bhoomi, and NIC Bhu-Naksha references.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service existence/status references were partially evidenced, but citywide parcel-vector access, exact-point containment, native schema/identity, CRS, and open coverage were not verified.
